about: Stable round 2 (R2-01) synthetic phase8-dev fixtures: personas, photo sources, reports and a small claim story. Photos are owner-supplied, licence-checked Flickr photos found through Openverse (batch A), or licence-checked Wikimedia Commons files (batch B, added when Commons downloads work); provenance is written by r2_prepare.py. Ground truth for image-search evaluation is kept outside Git in C:/ReFind-Laravel/fixtures/round2/EVALUATION_MANIFEST.json. Visible text never names fixture ids, pairs or roles.
